topic: Excluding vehicles from parallel traffic analysis
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining the analytics report to accurately exclude vehicles from parallel traffic calculations. It was determined that the initial approach of calculating parallel traffic only when both zones are crossed needs adjustment, especially due to interference from trams and other large objects.

Regarding data processing, it was noted that two existing queries (one for speed, one for size) should ideally be combined into a single, simpler query. The immediate priority is developing the exclusion logic for parallel traffic.

A separate, complex issue concerning the detection of long trams and cyclists was raised. This requires advanced tracking methods, potentially involving linking video data with database object IDs to accurately capture fragmented objects passing through the zone.
decisions: The report must be updated to exclude vehicles from parallel traffic calculations.
The two existing queries (speed and size) should be combined into a single query structure.
A background thread or separate effort is needed to address the complex detection of long trams and cyclists.
action_items: [me] will work on implementing the exclusion logic for parallel traffic, potentially completing it over the weekend.
Someone needs to provide video footage segments for re-testing the lidar ID test related to tram detection.
